hypotheses.X0_factorial_endpoints_are_exact: Externally supplied native/donor Layer-0 value buses reproduce ordinary native/donor executions to relative error at most 1e-6.
hypotheses.X1_repeated_injection_is_operator_releva: With initial state and persistent bus held native, donor x0 injection at all layers reproduces at least 0.50 of the full donor operator effect on every corpus.
hypotheses.X2_repeated_injection_is_behavior_releva: The injection-only coalition reproduces at least 0.30 of the full donor Fisher-logit effect on every corpus.
hypotheses.X3_initial_state_alone_is_not_sufficient: The initial-state-only coalition has operator and Fisher fidelity below 0.50 on every corpus.
hypotheses.X4_persistent_value_bus_is_not_sufficien: The persistent-bus-only coalition has operator and Fisher fidelity below 0.50 on every corpus.
hypotheses.X5_no_single_three_layer_injection_group: No isolated three-layer injection group reaches 0.80 operator fidelity to the all-layer injection effect on any corpus.
hypotheses.X6_late_injections_are_not_the_whole_his: Layers 15-17 alone retain at least 0.10 less operator fidelity than all repeated injections on every corpus.
hypotheses.X7_injection_shapley_is_positive: Repeated injection receives positive Shapley projection share in both operator and Fisher geometries on every corpus.
hypotheses.X8_pathway_attribution_is_not_metric_inv: At least one source's operator and Fisher Shapley projection shares differ by 0.10 or more on at least one corpus.
hypotheses.X9_source_ordering_transfers_ood: The ordering of the three Shapley projection shares is identical across corpora separately for operator and Fisher metrics.
hypotheses.X10_cross_entropy_does_not_reverse_injec: Injection-only CE-effect fidelity is positive on every corpus.
